about: The evangelium of the formulary “Commemoration of All the Faithful Departed — Mass I” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: At that time, Jesus said to the crowds of the Jews: Amen, amen I say to you that the hour is coming, and it is now, when the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God, and those who have heard will live. For as the Father has life in Himself, so He has granted that the Son also should have life in Himself; and He has given Him authority to execute judgment, because He is the Son of Man. Do not be amazed at this, for the hour is coming when all who are in the graves will hear the voice of the Son of God; and they will come forth, those who have done good, to the resurrection of life, but those who have practiced evil, to the resurrection of judgment.
